title: Claude Was Burning My Money Until I Did This
description:
Claude Code re-reads your entire project every single session, and you are paying for every word of it. This free tool builds a permanent map of your codebase once, so Claude goes straight to the right file instead of walking the whole repo. It hit number one trending on GitHub, it is MIT licensed, and the project's own research across 31 real repos measured 10x fewer tokens.

In this short: what the tool actually does in plain English, the exact two-step setup inside Claude Code, and the real numbers behind the claim.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1u9S_1_wk6AyyaWKykocplIIyWoeX9oQlln2JEz9E_uU/edit?usp=sharing
